description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) component for visualizing JSON-like data structures, including node rendering, navigation, styling, and user interaction mechanisms using the Bubble Tea framework and Lipgloss for styling.

classes.name: Styles
classes.description: A struct encapsulating styling options for different UI components, including shapes, selection highlight, unselected state, and help text styles.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the data structure with a key, type, collapsed state, value input model, and potential children nodes.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: Represents the main application state, including node data, UI dimensions, styles, cursor position, help display, and input handling.

classes.name: KeyMap
classes.description: Stores key bindings for navigation and control within the CLI interface.

methods.name: defaultStyles
methods.description: Creates and returns default style configurations for the UI components.

methods.name: isNodeVector
methods.description: Determines if a node is of a vector type (Object or ArrayObject).

methods.name: Nodes
methods.description: Returns the current list of nodes.

methods.name: SetNodes
methods.description: Sets the node list to a new set of nodes.

methods.name: NumberOfNodes
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of nodes, including nested children.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the current width of the UI viewport.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the current height of the UI viewport.

methods.name: SetSize
methods.description: Updates the width and height of the UI viewport.

methods.name: SetWidth
methods.description: Updates the width of the UI viewport.

methods.name: SetHeight
methods.description: Updates the height of the UI viewport.

methods.name: Cursor
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor position.

methods.name: Editable
methods.description: Returns whether the interface is editable.

methods.name: SetEditable
methods.description: Sets the editable state of the interface.

methods.name: SetShowHelp
methods.description: Returns whether the help menu is shown.

methods.name: NavUp
methods.description: Moves the cursor up by one node.

methods.name: NavDown
methods.description: Moves the cursor down by one node.

methods.name: NodeAtCursor
methods.description: Retrieves the node at the current cursor position, traversing nested nodes.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles input messages to update the application state, including navigation and help toggling.

methods.name: TreeView
methods.description: Returns the textual tree representation of the current nodes.

methods.name: View
methods.description: Renders the complete UI view, including the tree and help section.

methods.name: renderTree
methods.description: Recursively generates the visual representation of nodes with styles and indentation.

methods.name: helpView
methods.description: Renders the help text section.

methods.name: ShortHelp
methods.description: Provides a brief list of key bindings for quick reference.

methods.name: FullHelp
methods.description: Provides a detailed list of all key bindings.
